name: Google Cloud BigQuery
description: BigQuery is Google Cloud's fully managed, serverless enterprise data warehouse for SQL analytics at scale, with built-in machine learning, Apache Iceberg interoperability, and Gemini-based agents for natural-language and agentic data workflows, billed on consumption-based compute and storage pricing.
best_for: Teams that want a fully managed, serverless SQL data warehouse with a genuine ongoing free monthly usage allowance, consumption-based pricing as they scale, and built-in machine learning and AI-agent tooling on the same platform.
features: Fully managed, serverless data warehouse with no infrastructure to provision or manage
BigQuery ML for training, evaluating, and deploying predictive models directly with SQL, plus AI functions for tasks like text summarization and sentiment analysis
Native read/write interoperability with Apache Iceberg tables across BigQuery and other engines, with automated table maintenance (compaction, clustering) via Google Cloud Lakehouse
Knowledge Catalog for automatic metadata harvesting, data profiling, data quality checks, and lineage
Conversational Analytics Agent and other Gemini-based agents for natural-language querying and automating data preparation and pipeline building
High-throughput streaming ingestion (Storage Write API) alongside batch loading, with batch loads billed for free via the shared slot pool
Choice of on-demand (pay-per-TiB-scanned) or slot-based capacity pricing across Standard, Enterprise, and Enterprise Plus editions for query compute
Encryption by default, customer-managed encryption keys, and a stated 99.99% uptime SLA
pros: Genuine ongoing free monthly usage: every account gets 10 GB of storage and up to 1 TB of on-demand queries free per month, not just a one-time trial
A no-credit-card BigQuery sandbox lets you run queries against public or your own datasets while staying within the free tier automatically
New customers can additionally claim $300 in free credits on top of the standing monthly free allowance
cons: No flat starting price: on-demand compute, three slot-based editions, and storage are priced and billed separately, so estimating total monthly cost requires the pricing calculator
Query costs are based on data scanned, so an unoptimized query (missing partitioning or clustering) can cost more than expected even for a small result set

pricing.starting_price: Every account gets 10 GB storage and up to 1 TB of on-demand queries free per month; beyond that, on-demand queries start at $6.25 per TiB scanned and slot-based capacity pricing starts at $0.04 per slot-hour (Standard edition), plus separate storage charges starting around $0.01/GiB. New customers can also claim $300 in free credits. No flat starting price is published.

tiers.name: Free tier (all accounts)
tiers.notes: 10 GB storage and up to 1 TB of on-demand query processing free every month, for every account, not just new signups.

tiers.name: On-Demand compute
tiers.notes: Default pay-per-query compute pricing (Iowa/us-central1 rate; varies by region). First 1 TiB scanned per month is free, then billed per TiB of data scanned by each query.

tiers.name: Standard Edition (slot capacity)
tiers.notes: Pay-as-you-go reserved query-processing capacity (Iowa rate); billed per second with a 1-minute minimum. 1-year and 3-year commitments available at lower rates.

tiers.name: Enterprise Edition (slot capacity)
tiers.notes: Adds BigQuery ML capacity-based pricing and other Enterprise features over Standard edition; same billing structure and commitment discounts.

tiers.name: Enterprise Plus Edition (slot capacity)
tiers.notes: Highest slot-capacity edition; same billing structure and commitment discounts as Standard/Enterprise.

tiers.name: Storage
tiers.notes: Logical storage starts around $0.01/GiB/month (physical storage around $0.02/GiB/month); the first 10 GiB is free every month. Long-term storage (unmodified for 90+ consecutive days) bills at roughly half the active-storage rate. Rates shown are Iowa/us-central1 and vary by region.

alternatives.name: Snowflake
alternatives.description: A cross-cloud data platform for storage, compute, and AI/ML workloads, billed on Snowflake credits rather than Google Cloud's per-TiB-scanned and slot-hour model.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want a single warehouse platform that runs the same way across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, rather than a warehouse built natively into the Google Cloud ecosystem.
strengths: Cross-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), not tied to one cloud provider
Snowflake Marketplace for third-party data sharing

alternatives.name: Databricks
alternatives.description: A lakehouse platform unifying data engineering, SQL analytics, and machine learning on open formats like Delta Lake and Apache Iceberg, billed in Databricks Units (DBUs) rather than BigQuery's per-TiB-scanned and slot-hour pricing.
alternatives.best_for: Teams whose workloads lean heavily toward data engineering and custom ML model development across multiple clouds, rather than a primarily SQL-first warehouse tied to Google Cloud.
strengths: Runs natively across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud
Deep open-format lakehouse support (Delta Lake, Iceberg)

faq.question: Is BigQuery free?
faq.answer: Every BigQuery account gets 10 GB of storage and up to 1 TB of on-demand query processing free every month. New customers can also claim $300 in additional free credits, and a no-credit-card 'sandbox' mode lets you try queries while staying within the free tier automatically.

faq.question: How is BigQuery priced beyond the free tier?
faq.answer: BigQuery bills compute and storage separately. Query compute is either on-demand (starting at $6.25 per TiB of data scanned) or slot-based capacity pricing across Standard, Enterprise, and Enterprise Plus editions (starting at $0.04 per slot-hour for Standard). Storage bills separately, starting around $0.01 per GiB/month for logical storage, with the first 10 GiB free each month.

faq.question: Does using BigQuery require talking to sales?
faq.answer: No self-serve tier requires it — you can sign up, query, and scale entirely through the console at published rates. Google Cloud also offers an optional custom quote from its sales team for large projects.
